Page two · A message for you

For Little Sister Rubi

Dear Rubi,

Happy Birthday, little sister! Some people feel like family the moment they walk into your life, and you are truly one of them.

You have this rare, beautiful gift of making every room lighter and every ordinary conversation funnier. Thank you for the endless laughs, the goofy faces, and the warmth you bring wherever you go.

May this new year of your life be filled with gentle mornings, loud laughter, wild adventures, and dreams that come true before you even finish wishing for them.

Keep shining that bright, infectious smile — it looks absolutely wonderful on you!

With so much love,
Anna 💖
